title: Cauchy–Schwarz for the Boolean inner product
statement:
Let $n\ge0$ be an integer, let $f, g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be functions, and write $\E[h] = 2^{-n}\sum_{x
\in \{0,1\}^n} h(x)$ for the expectation under the uniform measure and $\langle f,
g\rangle = \E[f\cdot g]$ for the $L^2$ inner product. Then
\[
  \langle f, g\rangle \;\le\; \big(\E[f^2]\big)^{1/2}\,\big(\E[g^2]\big)^{1/2}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the n-dimensional cube
g is a Boolean function on the n-dimensional cube
